تختطفن (form VIII)
# تَخْتَطِفْنَ (taḵtaṭifna) /tax.ta.tˤif.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
# تُخْتَطَفْنَ (tuḵtaṭafna) /tux.ta.tˤaf.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
